label: 网格→场景节点
description: 占用/分区叠加：非零格子变成体素，不是地形。地貌请用 heightfieldMesh → meshSceneNode。
description-en: Occupancy overlay: non-zero grid cells become voxels. Not terrain. For landforms use heightfieldMesh → meshSceneNode.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.label: grid
inputs.description: 输入二维 grid（grid[y][x]）；非零值写入对应 (x,y,zBase) 体素
inputs.description-en: Input 2D grid (grid[y][x]); non-zero cells become voxels at (x,y,zBase).

inputs.name: schema
inputs.label: schema
inputs.description: 节点几何 schema 标签
inputs.description-en: Schema tag for the node geometry.

inputs.name: z
inputs.label: 高度层索引
inputs.description: 可选。等高线/高度场分层时接层号（0、1、2…）。未显式接 zRange 时，按 [0..z] 实心柱生成体素（避免互斥分区全落在 z=0）。
inputs.description-en: Optional elevation-tier index (0,1,2…). When zRange is not wired, emits a solid column of voxels at z=0..z — required for mutually exclusive contour partitions.

inputs.name: zRange
inputs.label: z 层
inputs.description: 体素 z 坐标列表；每个非零格在列表中每一层各生成一个体素。默认 [0] 表示单层平铺。若同时接了 z 且本口未接线，则以 z 的 [0..z] 实心柱为准。
inputs.description-en: List of z values; each non-zero cell emits one voxel per z in this list. Default [0] = single flat layer. Ignored when unset and `z` is provided (fill 0..z).

inputs.name: stateGrid
inputs.label: 标签 grid
inputs.description: 可选。与 grid 同尺寸的逐格标签网格；非零值经 stateValues 映射后写入体素的 state[stateKey]。autotile 规则用 face.variants 的 when.stateEquals 消费（如 bridge_25 区分端头长条横/竖）。
inputs.description-en: Optional per-cell tag grid (same size as grid). Non-zero values are mapped through stateValues and written to voxel state[stateKey], consumed by autotile rules via face.variants when.stateEquals.

inputs.name: stateKey
inputs.label: 标签键名
inputs.description: stateGrid 写入体素 state 时使用的键名。
inputs.description-en: Key under which stateGrid values are written into each voxel's state.

inputs.name: stateValues
inputs.label: 标签取值表
inputs.description: stateGrid 数值 → 标签字符串的映射表，按下标取（值 1 取第 2 项，依此类推）；缺项则直接用数字的字符串形式。
inputs.description-en: Lookup table mapping stateGrid numbers to tag strings by index (value 1 → item at index 1). Missing entries fall back to the number as a string.

outputs.name: scene
outputs.label: scene
outputs.description: 单节点 scene，focus 指向新节点；可直接喂下游 add_child / set_transform / node_explode
outputs.description-en: One-node scene with focus on the new node; feed into add_child / set_transform / node_explode.
